title: The First Morning
summary: He wakes in the otherworld and it is everything promised. The unease does not arrive until he asks a question nobody there understands.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of a lush valley of eternal summer, tall silver waterfalls spilling from green mountains into a still lake, wildflowers through the grass, warm light. Nothing moves but the water. Static camera.
Extreme wide shot. The warrior stands alone in the valley, small in the frame, looking up at the waterfalls. Static camera.
Close shot. The warrior's face in warm light, taking it in, not yet suspicious of it. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I have been awake an hour and I have not once thought about the weather. At home the weather is the first thought and the last one. Here it does not seem to be a thought at all.

scenes.visual: Extreme wide shot. The princess walks along the path beside the lake, small in the frame, unhurried. Static camera.
Wide two shot. The warrior and the princess stand a few paces apart on the grass, both full length, facing each other, the waterfall behind them. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face in warm light, pleased with him. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Nobody here talks about the weather because it does not do anything. It was like this before my grandmother and it will be like this after you. That is the whole of it.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The warrior's face. Something in that has caught on him and he is turning it over. Static camera.

dialogue.line: After me. You said after me. I have been here one morning and you have already put me on the other side of something.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The princess's face. She had not heard it that way and now she has. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I meant it kindly. I forget that the words are different for you. Here after me is a direction. For you it is a warning.

scenes.visual: Wide two shot. The two of them on the grass, neither speaking, the valley enormous around them. Static camera.
Close shot. The warrior's face, warm light on him, deciding not to pull the thread. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Then I will learn the words. I am good at that. I learned twelve of them for a woman in Kerry once and she married someone else anyway.

scenes.visual: Extreme wide shot. The warrior walks away across the valley toward the lake, small and unhurried, the waterfall behind him. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face, watching him go, the pleasure gone out of it. Static camera.

dialogue.line: He counted. On his first morning, with all of it in front of him, he counted. I am not going to tell him I noticed.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of the valley in warm light, the waterfalls falling, the lake still, nobody on the path. Static camera.
